name: core-runtime-system-scalar-adderror-tail-api67
notes: Exact-candidate local test witness for Boolean, Date, Datetime, Decimal, Double, Id, Integer, Long, and Time field addError overloads. Policy-local-only; no hosted Salesforce execution or parity claim is made.
salesforceExclusionReason: Field addError overloads are proven only by deterministic local trigger execution; this fixture makes zero hosted Salesforce parity claim.

source.content: trigger AddErrorScalar on Account (before insert) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.Name == 'Block') { a.Flag__c.addError('boolean field'); a.Flag__c.addError('boolean field escape', false); a.Flag__c.addError(new DmlException('boolean exception')); a.Flag__c.addError(new DmlException('boolean exception escape'), false); a.Date__c.addError('date field'); a.Date__c.addError('date field escape', false); a.Date__c.addError(new DmlException('date exception')); a.Date__c.addError(new DmlException('date exception escape'), false); a.Stamp__c.addError('datetime field'); a.Stamp__c.addError('datetime field escape', false); a.Stamp__c.addError(new DmlException('datetime exception')); a.Stamp__c.addError(new DmlException('datetime exception escape'), false); a.Amount__c.addError('decimal field'); a.Amount__c.addError('decimal field escape', false); a.Amount__c.addError(new DmlException('decimal exception')); a.Amount__c.addError(new DmlException('decimal exception escape'), false); a.Double__c.addError('double field'); a.Double__c.addError('double field escape', false); a.Double__c.addError(new DmlException('double exception')); a.Double__c.addError(new DmlException('double exception escape'), false); a.Parent__c.addError('id field'); a.Parent__c.addError('id field escape', false); a.Parent__c.addError(new DmlException('id exception')); a.Parent__c.addError(new DmlException('id exception escape'), false); a.Count__c.addError('integer field'); a.Count__c.addError('integer field escape', false); a.Count__c.addError(new DmlException('integer exception')); a.Count__c.addError(new DmlException('integer exception escape'), false); a.Long__c.addError('long field'); a.Long__c.addError('long field escape', false); a.Long__c.addError(new DmlException('long exception')); a.Long__c.addError(new DmlException('long exception escape'), false); a.Clock__c.addError('time field'); a.Clock__c.addError('time field escape', false); a.Clock__c.addError(new DmlException('time exception')); a.Clock__c.addError(new DmlException('time exception escape'), false); } } }

@isTest private class AddErrorScalarTest { @isTest static void scalarFieldAddErrorOverloads() { Boolean booleanWitness = true; Decimal decimalWitness = 1.0; Id idWitness = '001000000000001AAA'; Integer integerWitness = 1; System.assert(booleanWitness); System.assertEquals(1.0, decimalWitness); System.assertNotEquals(null, idWitness); System.assertEquals(1, integerWitness); Database.SaveResult result = Database.insert(new Account(Name='Block', Flag__c=true, Date__c=Date.today(), Stamp__c=Datetime.now(), Amount__c=12.5, Double__c=12.5, Parent__c='001000000000001AAA', Count__c=7, Long__c=7000000000L, Clock__c=Time.newInstance(8, 30, 0, 0)), false); System.assert(!result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(9, result.getErrors().size()); } }
